build_sparse_mat_vec: build a module that performs sparse matrix-vector multiplication using CSR format on CPU or CUDA
build_sparse_tmat_vec: build a module that performs sparse transpose matrix-vector multiplication using CSC format on CPU or CUDA
test_sparse_mv_autograd: test the sparse_mv autograd function for differentiable sparse matrix-vector multiplication
test_sparse_mtv_autograd: test the sparse_mtv autograd function for differentiable sparse transpose matrix-vector multiplication
create_random_sparse_matrix: create a random sparse matrix with configurable fill ratio and minimum entries per column
